methods_searched.description: true when the methods and the text were read for the unit and the time of every column, not only the header and footnotes.

columns_differing_from_table.description: column_ids whose statistic, statistic_stated or transformation_stated differ from the table and are written on the column.

records_with_valid_column.description: Records of this table whose column_id is one of the table's columns. Must equal records.

columns_match.description: true only when the three stage counts add up to columns, every record has a valid column_id, methods_searched is true and every harvest-stage column prints the harvest.

marker.description: The footnote marker as printed ('1', '(2)', 'a', '*', 'Tr'), or 'caption' or 'note' for a note printed above or below the table without a marker.

summary.description: What it says, in our own words or at most 15 words quoted.

applied_to.description: column_ids it went into, 'table' when it went to table_level_labels, 'trial' when it went to trials[], 'none' when it holds nothing for the values (say why in summary).

dose_source_pages.description: Pages where the doses of this trial are printed.

product_treatments.description: Treatments of this trial that received a product, fertilizer or input with a dose (checks excluded).

records_with_product.description: Records of this trial with active_ingredient_or_input not null.

records_with_dose.description: Records of this trial with dose_and_unit not null.

multi_dose_cells.description: Cells of a treatment table or methods list that hold the doses of several treatments, or several doses of one product used by different treatments.

multi_dose_cells_resolved.description: Of those, how many were resolved so that each treatment's records carry only its own product and dose. Must equal multi_dose_cells.

both_forms_printed.description: true when the treatment table or methods print the dose of the products both as commercial product and as active ingredient (rule DOSE IN BOTH FORMS).

records_with_both_forms.description: Records of this trial whose dose_and_unit holds both forms. Equals records_with_dose when both_forms_printed is true.

application_count_source.description: Where n_applications of this trial comes from: printed = a number in the text or table; counted_from_design = counted from a treatment table or calendar that marks dates or stages per treatment (rule COUNT THE APPLICATIONS); varies_by_treatment_counted = each treatment counted on its records; not_printed = no number and no countable list; not_applicable = no applied treatments.

spray_volume_kept_out.description: true when no dose_and_unit of this trial contains the spray volume.

uniform_sprays_kept_out.description: true when no record of this trial carries a uniform spray in active_ingredient_or_input, dose_and_unit, application_stages or n_applications (rule UNIFORM SPRAYS ARE CONTEXT).

doses_match.description: true only when every record of a product treatment has its product and its own dose (or the dose is printed nowhere for it), multi_dose_cells_resolved = multi_dose_cells, both forms are carried when printed, spray_volume_kept_out and uniform_sprays_kept_out are true, and application_count_source is not counted_from_design with records left without their count.

damage_or_disease_rated.description: Does the document rate any pest, disease, damage or disorder in this trial (counts, severity, incidence, scores, AUDPC, damaged or rotten tubers, tuber defects when the trial is about them)? Plant height and tuber shape rated as traits do not count.

rated_targets.description: The targets rated in this trial, from the biotic_target enum. Empty when nothing is rated.

rated_pages.description: Pages where those ratings are printed.

trial_biotic_target.description: trials[].biotic_target as written. Not none when damage_or_disease_rated is true.

production_columns.description: Columns of this trial that measure yield, tubers, plant or economics rather than a pest or disease.

production_columns_with_trial_target.description: Of those, how many carry the trial's target in columns[].biotic_target. Must equal production_columns.

targets_match.description: true only when trial_biotic_target is not none whenever damage_or_disease_rated is true, and production_columns_with_trial_target = production_columns.

changes_from_trigo_v7: Uniform sprays are context: new trial field uniform_sprays and rule UNIFORM SPRAYS ARE CONTEXT. Pesticides applied the same way to every plot of a trial whose treatment is something else stay out of the records (no product, dose, stages or count), with wheat chagas2026 and maciel2015 as the closed example (436 fields in the wheat round). end_checklist.doses.uniform_sprays_kept_out checks it.

Count the applications: rule COUNT THE APPLICATIONS. When a treatment table or calendar marks the dates or stages of each treatment, n_applications is their count, on the trial or per record (wheat ramos1976, 110 fields). end_checklist.doses.application_count_source says where the count came from.

Dose in both forms: rule DOSE IN BOTH FORMS. Where commercial-product and active-ingredient doses are both printed, every record carries both, with the page of the treatment table (wheat goulart1999, 224 fields). end_checklist.doses gets both_forms_printed and records_with_both_forms.

Units and times from the methods: columns[] gets unit_source_place and crop_stage_source_place, and end_checklist.columns counts the columns whose unit came from the methods or text, those with no unit anywhere and whether the methods were searched (wheat brancao2004, 117 fields; picinini1999, 38).

Never invent a stage: rule NEVER INVENT A STAGE. A yield or tuber-quality column takes a harvest stage only when the harvest is printed with a date, a day count or a stage; otherwise not_printed (wheat silva1991 and salvadori1999, 156 fields). end_checklist.columns counts the harvest-stage columns.

Marginal columns: rule MARGINAL ROWS AND COLUMNS gets the closed examples 'Conjunto' (wheat ramos1976) and 'Médio' (wheat lima2005), 59 fields in the wheat round, and says that a Total column adding size classes is a variable, not a marginal.
Tuber size classes: new column_axis_kind size_classes and column field size_class, so a yield or number per grading class keeps the class on the column and the treatment unchanged.

Trial context for potato: sowing_date becomes planting_date, seeding_rate_or_spacing becomes spacing_or_density; new fields seed_tuber and uniform_sprays; environment adds storage. biotic_target rebuilt for late and early blight, black scurf, Fusarium, Verticillium, common and powdery scab, silver scurf, bacterial wilt, blackleg and soft rot, PVY, PLRV and virus complexes, tuber moth, aphids, Diabrotica, whitefly, leafminer, thrips, soil pests, nematodes, physiological disorders and storage rots.

Vocabulary rebuilt for potato: total, marketable, non-marketable, per-plant and size-class tuber yield, size-class share, tuber number and mean mass, dry matter, specific gravity, tuber chemistry, processing quality, tuber defects, tuber physical traits, sprouting and dormancy, storage loss, stems per plant, canopy cover, seed-tuber infection; the wheat grain, spike, hectoliter, flour, forage and mycotoxin terms are gone. treatment_type adds seed_tuber_treatment, nematicide, seed_tuber, planting_date, spacing_density, haulm_desiccation and storage. plant_part becomes leaves, upper and lower leaves, stem, canopy, tuber, tuber flesh, seed tuber, root, whole plant and plot. crop_stage_refers_to adds planting, tuber_initiation, flowering, haulm_desiccation and storage.
